events.title: Germanic tribes destroy three Roman legions in the Teutoburg Forest
events.description: Arminius led Germanic warriors in an ambush that wiped out three legions under Varus over several days, by tradition ending around this date. Rome never again tried to conquer Germany beyond the Rhine.
events.html: Arminius led Germanic warriors in an ambush that wiped out three legions under Varus over several days, by tradition ending around this date. Rome never again tried to conquer Germany beyond the Rhine.

events.title: William the Conqueror dies in Rouen
events.description: William I died of injuries received at the burning of Mantes. Normandy went to his eldest son Robert and England to William Rufus, a division that set his heirs against each other.
events.html: William I died of injuries received at the burning of Mantes. Normandy went to his eldest son Robert and England to William Rufus, a division that set his heirs against each other.

events.title: Congress adopts the name 'United States of America'
events.description: The Continental Congress resolved that wherever 'United Colonies' had been used, the new nation should be styled the 'United States'. The name had appeared in the Declaration two months earlier.
events.html: The Continental Congress resolved that wherever 'United Colonies' had been used, the new nation should be styled the 'United States'. The name had appeared in the Declaration two months earlier.

events.title: California becomes the 31st US state
events.description: California entered the Union as a free state under the Compromise of 1850, two years after gold was found at Sutter's Mill. Its admission upset the balance between free and slave states.
events.html: California entered the Union as a free state under the Compromise of 1850, two years after gold was found at Sutter's Mill. Its admission upset the balance between free and slave states.

events.title: North Korea is proclaimed under Kim Il-sung
events.description: The Democratic People's Republic of Korea was proclaimed in the Soviet-occupied north, weeks after the Republic of Korea in the south. Kim Il-sung founded a dynasty that still rules.
events.html: The Democratic People's Republic of Korea was proclaimed in the Soviet-occupied north, weeks after the Republic of Korea in the south. Kim Il-sung founded a dynasty that still rules.

events.title: Elvis Presley first appears on The Ed Sullivan Show
events.description: Some 60 million Americans, over 80 per cent of the TV audience, watched Elvis's first appearance on Sullivan's show. The 'waist up' camera shots came only on his third appearance in 1957.
